ops.title: Move sessions from memory to Redis
ops.markdown:
# Move sessions from memory to Redis

Sessions currently live in an in-process `Map`, so they vanish on deploy and cannot be shared between the two API replicas.

## Prepare

- [ ] Add `ioredis` and a `REDIS_URL` setting with a local default
- [ ] Introduce a `SessionBackend` interface that both stores implement

## Implement

- [ ] Write `RedisSessionStore` using `SET key value PX ttl` and `GETEX` for sliding expiry
- [ ] Keep `MemorySessionStore` for tests and single-node development
- [ ] Select the backend from config at startup

## Verify

- [ ] Run the existing session tests against both backends
- [ ] Add a test that a session survives a store restart
- [ ] Remove the sweeper when Redis is active (Redis expires keys itself)
